phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Springfield 1903A4 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .30-06 Springfield (7.62×63mm) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 405 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 405 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 610 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 853 m/s (3820 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Manual Bolt Cycle & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 5-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Springfield 1903A4 staged for its 15 RPM (Manual Swept-Down Sniper Bolt) cadence.

zh.headline: 斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪：1903 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 斯普林菲尔德 M1903 汲取毛瑟 98 经典双前突笋加第三安全突笋与大型非旋转抽壳钩的受控供弹精髓；二战中由雷明顿量产的 M1903A4 狙击型去除机械瞄具，换装低矮红场燕尾镜座与 M73B1（Weaver 330C）2.5 倍瞄准镜，陪伴美军征战欧亚两大战场。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Springfield 1903A4 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1903 年问世的 斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪 由美国斯普林菲尔德兵工厂 / 雷明顿主导研制，定位为经典的受控供弹栓动狙击步枪。美军在 1898 年美西战争见识西班牙毛瑟步枪威力后研制 M1903，并正式向德国毛瑟公司支付了 20 万美元专利许可费；二战期间 M1903A4 成为美军最著名的狙击步枪之一。
斯普林菲尔德 M1903 汲取毛瑟 98 经典双前突笋加第三安全突笋与大型非旋转抽壳钩的受控供弹精髓；二战中由雷明顿量产的 M1903A4 狙击型去除机械瞄具，换装低矮红场燕尾镜座与 M73B1（Weaver 330C）2.5 倍瞄准镜，陪伴美军征战欧亚两大战场。 整件装备总长 1,098 mm（全长胡桃木“C”型手枪握把托）、空重 4.25 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1903 年，美国斯普林菲尔德兵工厂 / 雷明顿推出了划时代的斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪。美军在 1898 年美西战争见识西班牙毛瑟步枪威力后研制 M1903，并正式向德国毛瑟公司支付了 20 万美元专利许可费；二战期间 M1903A4 成为美军最著名的狙击步枪之一。 它的核心设计聚焦于双前闭锁突笋 + 后置第三保险突笋 + 非旋转长爪抽壳钩，倒置装弹亦绝不漏供，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「旋转后拉式栓动 · 毛瑟式三突笋受控供弹 + 5 发桥夹内置弹仓」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。专为狙击任务取消准星照门，采用低轴线红场镜座与 2.5× M73B1 光学瞄具，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪 采用旋转后拉式栓动 · 毛瑟式三突笋受控供弹 + 5 发桥夹内置弹仓。在每个击发周期中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了专为狙击任务取消准星照门，采用低轴线红场镜座与 2.5× M73B1 光学瞄具。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .30-06 Springfield (7.62×63mm) 弹药规格与 610 mm（24 in）· 4 条右旋膛线（1:254 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 405 MPa，可赋予弹头 853 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,820 J 动能，有效作用距离达 800 米。
内膛技术特点方面，1:254 mm 精密膛线搭配 .30-06 M2 尖头弹，战时亦经实验证明 2 线管精度同等优异。同时，独有“弹仓切断开关（Magazine Cut-Off）”可切换单发装填并保留弹仓 5 发应急，令其在 15 发/分（手动下弯防碰镜拉机柄） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 610 毫米身管与 .30-06 Springfield (7.62×63mm) 口径，斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪 实现了每秒 853 米的初速与 800 米有效射程。1:254 mm 精密膛线搭配 .30-06 M2 尖头弹，战时亦经实验证明 2 线管精度同等优异，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 5 发容量的机匣内置固定盒式弹仓与 36 mm 膛轴设计，斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 11.8 N·s 水平。610 mm 枪管赋予 .30-06 弹药 853 m/s 高初速与 3,820 J 充沛存能。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-74）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 5 发容量的机匣内置固定盒式弹仓与出色的整体工效，610 mm 枪管赋予 .30-06 弹药 853 m/s 高初速与 3,820 J 充沛存能。欢迎在 BAY-74 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 斯普林菲尔德 M1903A4 栓动狙击步枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Springfield M1903A4: The 1903 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Blending Mauser-derived 3-lug lockup and a full-length non-rotating claw extractor for controlled round feed, the WWII Remington-built M1903A4 sniper deleted iron sights in favor of a Redfield dovetail mount and M73B1 (Weaver 330C) optic. acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Springfield 1903A4
paragraphs: Introduced in 1903 by Springfield Armory / Remington in United States, the Springfield M1903A4 emerged as a defining Controlled-Round-Feed Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle. Shocked by Spanish Mausers in 1898, the U.S. developed the M1903 (paying Mauser $200,000 in royalties); in WWII, over 28,000 M1903A4 sniper rifles served from Normandy to the Pacific.

Blending Mauser-derived 3-lug lockup and a full-length non-rotating claw extractor for controlled round feed, the WWII Remington-built M1903A4 sniper deleted iron sights in favor of a Redfield dovetail mount and M73B1 (Weaver 330C) optic. Measuring 1,098 mm (Full-Length Walnut Pistol-Grip Stock) at an unloaded weight of 4.25 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1903, Springfield Armory / Remington of United States introduced the Springfield M1903A4. Shocked by Spanish Mausers in 1898, the U.S. developed the M1903 (paying Mauser $200,000 in royalties); in WWII, over 28,000 M1903A4 sniper rifles served from Normandy to the Pacific. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Dual front lugs, third safety lug, and non-rotating claw extractor guarantee controlled round feed — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Springfield M1903A4 sits its Turn-Bolt Action · Mauser-Derived 3-Lug Controlled Round Feed & 5-Round Internal Box Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering, containing 405 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Purpose-built sniper receiver omits iron sights for low-profile Redfield M73B1 optical mounting, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Springfield M1903A4 relies on Turn-Bolt Action · Mauser-Derived 3-Lug Controlled Round Feed & 5-Round Internal Box Magazine. During each cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Purpose-built sniper receiver omits iron sights for low-profile Redfield M73B1 optical mounting.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .30-06 Springfield (7.62×63mm) with 610 mm (24 in) · 4-Groove RH Rifling (1:254 mm Twist), the Springfield M1903A4 develops 853 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,820 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 800 meters.

Internally, 1:254 mm twist stabilized .30-06 M2 Ball accurately across both 4-groove and wartime 2-groove Remington barrels. Combined with its 15 RPM (Manual Swept-Down Sniper Bolt) tempo, Signature magazine cut-off lever allows single-loading while holding 5 rounds in reserve, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .30-06 Springfield (7.62×63mm) through its 610 millimeter bore, the Springfield M1903A4 achieves 853 meters per second and 800 meters of effective reach. 1:254 mm twist stabilized .30-06 M2 Ball accurately across both 4-groove and wartime 2-groove Remington barrels.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 5-round internal fixed box magazine with a 36 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 11.8 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. 24-inch barrel launches .30-06 Springfield at 853 m/s and 3,820 J out to 800 meters.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-74), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
